scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend:win: python -m venv factchecker\venv && call factchecker\venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r factchecker\requirements.txt
scripts.setup:backend:nix: python3 -m venv factchecker/venv && factchecker/venv/bin/python -m pip install -r factchecker/requirements.txt
scripts.setup:backend: npm run setup:backend:win || npm run setup:backend:nix
scripts.dev:backend: npm run dev:backend:win || npm run dev:backend:nix
